elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Rendered: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT ... EXCEED ..." — the one-sided "TRUELINK'S LIABILITY" has been replaced with "EITHER PARTY'S", so the cap now runs both directions and no unlimited-Client language remains.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered cap is only "THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD": no USD 1,000,000 floor, no "paid or payable", no anchor to the event giving rise to the claim, and the fee base is narrowed to hosting and support compensation only.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: No exclusion-of-damages language appears in the rendered operative text or in the cited paragraphs; the drafter's rationale confirms a mutual consequential-damages exclusion is absent and was not pressed.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Parenthetical carve-out: "OTHER THAN A PARTY'S ... BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS ... WHICH ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION".

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The carve-out list is limited to indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct; data protection and security obligations are not mentioned.
Carve-out expressly excludes "A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS" from the limitation, covering both the Section 12a Client indemnity and the 12b TrueLink indemnity.
Carve-out retains and mutualises "GROSS NEGLIGENCE" (previously only TrueLink's) as not subject to the limitation.
Carve-out retains and mutualises "WILLFUL MISCONDUCT" as not subject to the limitation.
Fraud does not appear in the rendered carve-out parenthetical or anywhere in the cited text.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No IP-infringement carve-out in the rendered sentence; only indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct are excluded.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: No language stating that Client's obligation to pay fees is not "damages" subject to the cap; nothing in the rendered sentence addresses payment obligations.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT" — mutual and agreement-wide rather than TrueLink-only under selected sections.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Retained existing basis: "EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD" — a 12-month fee measure keyed to the principal services (hosting and support), so not illusory.
"OTHER THAN A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS ... WHICH ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION".

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: "BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS" is inside the not-subject-to-limitation parenthetical.
"GROSS NEGLIGENCE" carved out for either party.
"WILLFUL MISCONDUCT" carved out for either party.

reasons: Fallback is position-complete: the single edited sentence delivers mutuality ("EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY"), retains the existing 12-month fee basis, and carves indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct out of the cap.

Preferred is not reached: missing USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable" and event-giving-rise-to-the-claim anchor, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, and carve-outs for data protection/security, fraud and IP infringement, plus the payment-obligations carve-in. The comment correctly does not claim these.

Minimal: the drafter edited the existing sentence rather than inserting the model clause, added no survival tail, expense language, extra damages categories or procedures, and added no carve-out beyond the fallback list.

Intent preserved: replacing the garbled and dangling "SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT" scope with "THIS AGREEMENT" removes a broken cross-reference and is required for an aggregate mutual cap; the indemnities in 12a/12b survive and now sit outside the cap for both parties.

Note for the drafter (rationale-level, not a defect at fallback): broadening the cap from selected sections to the whole Agreement also caps TrueLink's previously uncapped liability outside those sections; this is inherent in an aggregate mutual cap but should be flagged if the counterparty resists the carve-outs.

Note: the retained fee basis is narrowed to "COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES" and "IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS" has no stated anchor event; acceptable at the fallback but worth fixing to "fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" if negotiation reopens.
